newsitem.title: GERMANY: DIW sees 2.0 pct German GDP growth in H1, H2 1997.
newsitem.headline: DIW sees 2.0 pct German GDP growth in H1, H2 1997.

text.p: German economic research institute DIW said it expects the German economy to grow 2.0 percent in the first half of 1997, and the same rate in the second half.
In a report released on Tuesday, the institute also said it expects the economy to show 2.5 percent growth for the second half of 1996.
Earlier, the institute said it expects the economy to show 2.0 percent growth for all of 1997, and 1.5 percent for 1996.
